description: Retrieve up to limit (default 20) deterministically ranked memory records for a query (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call) and return { results, total_candidates } with per-item { memory, score }. Ranks up to 500 candidates in namespace by lexical/BM25 match, salience, tier boost (core=1.5x, semantic=1.25x), and 30-day freshness; mode biases domain relevance (organizational, research, operational, sales, support, personal) while limit caps item count independently of token_budget. Use when you need individual memory IDs, metadata, or scores (for inspection, feedback, or forget_memory); use build_context instead for a pre-formatted <memory_context> prompt block, or search_code for code symbols.

limit.description: Hard cap on returned { memory, score } items (default 20).

mode.description: Optional domain retrieval profile override (organizational, research, operational, sales, support, or personal).

namespace.description: Logical workspace namespace filter (defaults to MEMORIA_NAMESPACE or "default"; never prefix with "org:").

query.description: Keywords or natural-language question to match against stored memories.

token_budget.description: Advisory token budget hint (~4 chars/token) for sizing downstream context.

name: recall_memories

total_candidates.description: Total candidate memories evaluated in the namespace.

title: Recall Memories
